༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde ma lus pa 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI114_dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde ma lus pa 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i me 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru bhaṭ+ṭa rak+ka mañdzu badz+ra mahā kro dha ya na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje khro bo chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab gzugs/ /gur gum gzhon nu'i mdangs 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir mi zad khro bo'i sku/ /bdud dgra dpal ldan ma he'i dbang por 'dud/ /lha mchog gang des gdul bya mchog dman kun/ /rjes su gzung phyir mi yi tshul 'dzin pa'i/ /sa skya'i rje btsun brgyud par bcas rnams la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang / /rdo rje 'chang dngos mus pa chen po sogs/ /bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i mgon rnams rgyal/ /gzhan yang lugs 'di'i smin grol drin nos pa'i/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags dang / /spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan la sogs pa/ /yongs 'dzin bslu med mchog rnams phyag gi gnas/ /de ltar mchod par brjod nas lhag pa'i lha/ /khro dbang rdo rje 'jigs byed sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rnam bshad bdud sde 'joms pa'i me 'od 'di/ /'chad par 'gyur gyi don gnyer dga' bas nyon/ /de la 'dir dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde ma lus pa 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i me 'od ces bya ba 'di bshad par bya ba la don bdun te/ rgyud sde so so'i dbye ba/ gtan la dbab bya'i rgyud 'di gang gi phyogs su gtogs dpyad pa/ der gtogs pa'i rgyud 'di rdo rje 'chang gis ji ltar gsungs tshul/ de ltar gsungs pa'i brjod bya'i don bstan tshul/ bye brag tu bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis ji ltar bkral tshul/

bod kyi bla ma gang gi rjes su 'brang nas dpyad pa/ nyams su blang bya'i bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung la brten nas bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ grub chen sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mtshan brjod rnal 'byor du bkral ba dang / grub chen kun dga' snying pos gsang 'dus dang / rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / ma rgyud sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rnams rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral bas/ yo ga rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi gong na de las lhag pa'i rgyud sde gong ma yod par mi bzhed pa'i/ rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis kyi steng du rnal 'byor rgyud dang / rgyud sde gsum du bzhed la/ yang ye shes rdo rje kun las btus las/ sngags dang / sman dang / sbyin sreg dang / phye ma dang / mig sman dang / rkang byug la sogs pa dngos grub chen po brgyad rab tu spyod pas sgrub par byed pa'i rtog pa'i rgyud la bzhugs so/ /zhes bya rgyud kyi 'og tu rtog pa'i rgyud ces pa gsungs pas/ de'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyis rgyud sde lngar yang gsungs la/ yang 'phags pas rim lnga sgyu lus kyi skabs su/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid du rgyud sde rnam pa bzhi la mkhas pa/ zhes gsungs pas/ sngar bshad pa'i rgyud sde de nyid bya rgyud kyi nang du 'dus pa la dgongs pa yin par dgongs nas rgyud sde bzhir yang bzhed pa yin no/ /yang bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u nga gcig par/ ji srid mdo bya spyod pa ni/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbye ba nyid/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /de dang de la dga' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ /grub chen nā ro pa dpon slob kyis/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi steng du rnal 'byor gsang ba pha bla na med pa/ ma bla na med pa/ ma'i yang ma gsang mtha'i rgyud sde drug tu bzhed pa yang yod kyang / 'dir rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/

/bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes dang / dpal kha sbyor las/ rgod dang blta dang lag bcing dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhir gnas/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs pa la brten nas/ grub chen bir+wa pa dpon slob kyis rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyis rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges par bzhed pa yin no/ /'dir srin bu'i tshul zhes pa'i don ni/ srin bus shing zos shing / rang nyid 'phel bar byed pa bzhin/ /rgod pa la sogs pa 'dod chags kyi kun spyod bzhis lam gyi rtog pa zos te/ chos nyid kyi ngo bo gsal bar byed pa ston pas de ltar du bzhed pa yin no/ /'o na 'dir rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gnyis su bshad na/ de'i khyad par 'byed tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'di la mkhas pa kha cig skyes pa 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa dang / phos zhus pa pha rgyud dang / bud med 'dul ba'i don du gsungs pa dang / mos zhus pa de ma rgyud dang / de la sogs pa dur khrod yod med dang / rdzogs rim la rlung gtso bor ston pa dang / rtsa thig gtso bor ston pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'byed par byed pa ni rgyu mtshan phyogs re tsam ston nus kyang / khyad par 'byed byed kyi gtso bo ngos zin pa ni ma yin no/ /'o na de'i khyad par 'byed tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ kye rdor 'bum phrag lnga'i lung rdo rje snying 'grel du drangs par/ gang du thabs ni kun spyod cing / /shes rab gnas par gyur pa ni/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor pha rgyud du/ /gang yin de ni nga yis bshad/ /gang du shes rab kun spyod cing / /thabs ni gnas par gyur pa ni/ /kun rdzob rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /gang yin de ni nga yis bshad/ /kyai rdor gyi ni phyogs gcig min/

/don ni 'dus pa la sogs pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'dis thabs shes gnyis ni/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis la zer ba yin pas/ gang rdzogs rim yang ston cing bskyed rim brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa ni pha rgyud yin la/ gang bskyed rim yang ston cing / rdzogs rim brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas ston pa ni ma rgyud du gsungs pa yin cing / bskyed rdzogs gnyis po cha mnyam du brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas gsungs pa'i kye rdo rje'i rgyud ni/ pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gang las kyang zab pas thabs shes rab bdag nyid kyi rgyud ces pa'i tha snyad byed pa yin te/ 'di'i don gyi 'dus pa la sogs pa zhes pa ni/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis cha mnyam du 'dus pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas/ shes rab dang / thabs kyi bdag nyid kyi rgyud ces pa'i tha snyad byed pa yin la/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las kyang / thabs dang shes bar bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyi nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa yang 'di la dgongs pa yin no/ /'o na rgyud sde lngar 'gyur bas rang lugs la rgyud sde bzhir phye ba dang mi 'gal lam zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ 'dir ma rgyud spyi las gzhan du gyur pa'i thabs dang / shes rab bdag nyid rgyud ces pa'i rgyud sde lhag po gcig 'dod pa ma yin gyi/ ma rgyud gzhan las brjod bya'i gtso bor rim gnyis cha mnyam par gsal bar ston pas de skad du brjod pa yin no/ /de ltar min na/ gong du drangs pa'i 'bum lnga'i lung gis/ kyai rdor gyi ni phyogs gcig min/ /don gyi 'dus pa la sogs pa/ /shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig la nus pa med par 'gyur ro/ /des na brjod bya'i gtso bor bskyed rdzogs gnyis po de brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas/ gang gsal bar ston pa de pha rgyud dang ma rgyud du 'jog byed kyi gtso bo yin te/ grub chen nag po spyod pa bas/

gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba las/ dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lam gyi ni/ /rim pa gnyis ka'i ngo bo la/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa lhag yid 'ong / /rgyud rnams kun dpon gtso bo yin/ /dus ni rnam bzhi'i dbye ba yin/ /rgyud ni rnam pa bzhir 'gyur te/ /dgod pa dang ni bltas pa dang / /de bzhin gzhan ni lag bcing dang / /gnyis gnyis sprod pa bzhi pa ste/ /de dag rgyud ni rnam pa bzhi/ /'dus pa rnam pa gnyis gsungs te/ /bskyed dang rdzogs byung rim pa'o/ /rnal 'byor bskyed par bstan pa ste/ /rdzogs pa rnal 'byor ma ru brjod/ /dbang po gnyis ka'i snyoms 'jug pa/ /'dus pa zhes byar rnam par brjod/ /ces gsungs pas/ rgyud sde bzhir grangs nges dang / bla med kyi rgyud la dpal ldan 'dus pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byas nas/ de'i 'dus rgyu'i chos ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis la byas nas/ bskyed rim yang ston cing / rdzogs rim brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas gsal bar ston pa ma rgyud/ gang rdzogs rim yang ston cing / bskyed rim brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas gsal bar ston pa pha rgyud du gsal bar gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir bla med kyi rgyud yin na/ de'i rtsa bshad gnyis nas rim pa gnyis ka dngos shugs gang rung nas ston dgos pa yin te/ 'dir bla med kyi rgyud la dpal 'dus pa zhes pa'i tha snyad byas nas/ 'dus rgyu yang bskyed rdzogs gnyis la byas pas/ des na rim gnyis gang rung gcig ma tshang na 'dus pa'i tha snyad nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na bla med rgyud la pha rgyud dang / ma rgyud gnyis su byung na/ de gnyis kyi rnam gzhag ji ltar yin zhe na/ ma rgyud la sgo drug dang / pha rgyud la sde gsum gyi rnam gzhag mkhas pa snga ma dag gis byed pa ltar yin la/ de la ma rgyud kyi sgo drug ni/ he ru ka'i sgo/ rtag pa'i sgo/ rdo rje nyi ma'i sgo/ pad+ma gar dbang gi sgo/ rta mchog gi sgo/

rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo dang drug yin la/ de'ang he ru ka'i sgo ni/ kye rdo rje'i rtsa bshad cha mthun pa la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams dang / de bzhin du 'khor lo bde mchog mahā ma ya/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo rnams kyi rtsa bshad dang cha mthun pa'i rgyud rnams yin zhing / kha cig dus 'khor ma rgyud du mi 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ he ru ka ni dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi 'khor lo gcig pu nyid/ /ces gsungs/ gnyis pa rtag pa'i sgo ni/ mi g.yo ba bla med dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rtsa bshad/ gsang ba thams cad pa rnams so/ /gsum pa rdo rje nyi ma'i sgo ni/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud do/ /bzhi pa pad+ma gar dbang gi sgo ni/ 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa'i rgyud dang / ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa'o/ /lnga pa rta mchog gi sgo ni sgrol ma bla med kyi rgyud rnams so/ /drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo ni/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud do/ /'di rnams kyi rgyu mtshan rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa pha rgyud kyi rnam gzhag la/ zla gsang thig le las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gi /rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ ma rgyud la sde gsum du mdzad nas/ de la yang gtso bor 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud/ gtso bor zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud/ gti mug can gtso bor 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa ni/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud de pha rgyud sde gsum du bya ba yin la/ rgyud sde 'di gsum gtso bor nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba dug gsum la gtso bor spyod pa'i gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba btul na/ de'i yan lag rnams kyang zhor la 'dul ba la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin no/

/'o na rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa lnga bshad na/ 'di gsum la sgos su nyon mongs kyi rtsa ba dug gsum du bshad pa'i don ci yin snyam na/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku'i rtsa ba'i yon tan mthar thug pa sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang lnga yin kyang / sku gsung thugs gsum po de sangs rgyas de'i yon tan gyi rtsa ba yin zhing / de'i yon tan dang / 'phrin las rnams ni de gsum gyi cho 'phrul yin pa bzhin 'dir sbyang gzhi'i nyon mongs pa yang gti mug sogs rtsa ba'i dug gsum ni nyon mongs pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang 'dra la/ ser sna dang phrag dog ni de la brten nas byung bas de'i yon tan dang 'phrin las lta bu yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa'i pha rgyud sde gsum gyi gtso bo lta bu ni dpal gsang ba 'dus pa yin la/ de'i dbang du mdzad nas dpal dgra nag gi rgyud las/ rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'di gzhan las zab tshul gyi khyad par mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi'i bshad pa rnams/ nyams len bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khyad kyi bshad pa rnams ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar ston pa'i rgyud 'di la rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas te le'u bco brgyad du byas pa dang / de'i bshad rgyud la don gyi cha gsal bar ston pa ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ tshig gi cha gsal bar ston pa dgongs pa lung ston/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus/ rdo rje phreng ba cha mthun gyi rgyud/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud de rtsa bshad kyi rgyud bdun tsam zhig yod la/ gnyis pa gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la/ dmar nag gnyis las/ dmar po'i rgyud la/ lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa dang / lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor kho na ston pa le'u nyer gnyis pa ste dmar po'i rgyud gnyis yod la/

nag po'i rgyud la/ dgra nag gi rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ 'di gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa dang cha mthun/ gshin rje gshed kyi 'phrul 'khor gsal bar ston pa gdong drug gi rgyud sdom pa gsum pa/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la/ bod du 'gyur ba la rtog pa bdun pa 'di kho na yin la/ kha cig rtog bdun gyi 'khrul 'khor byed tshul mi gsal ba gsal bar ston pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud rtog pa gsum pa zhes zer nas/ rtog gsum rgyud du 'dod pa snang na'ang / sngon gyi mkhas pa mang pos rgyud du mi 'dod pa rtsod pa can du snang ngo / /gzhan 'di'i rgyud du 'dod pa'i gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa zhes pa dang / las mkhan te'u lo pa'i rtog pa zhes pa dang / gshin rje brang dmar gyi rtog pa rgyud du 'dod pa 'di rnams ni rgyud yin pa'i don med do/ /spyi don gnyis pa gtan la dbab bya'i rgyud 'di gang gi phyogs su gtogs dpyad pa ni/ 'dir gtan la dbab bya'i rgyud ni dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa 'di yin la/ 'di de ltar rgyud sde bzhir phye ba'i nang nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud du gtogs pa yin te/ rgyud 'di nyid las/ dur sogs gnas la bsgom bya zhing / /rtag tu bdud rtsi lnga rnams bza'/ /de las 'bras bu 'grub gzhan med/ /gzhan yang mar me cher za zhing / /zhes sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la longs spyod par bshad pa dang / bris sku'i rtog pa'i skabs su/ dur khrod brgyad bris nas de sgom par bshad pa sogs rgyu mtshan mang po gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i nang nas kyang zhe sdang can gtso bor 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa'i dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud kyi nang du gtogs te/ rgyu mtshan mang du spros pas chog go /kha cig na re/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud 'di ni rgyud sde bzhir phye ba'i bya rgyud du gtogs te/ bya rgyud du rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs/

zhes bshad pa dang / spyod rgyud du yang gtogs te/ drag shul gyi las gtso bor ston pa dang / rnal 'byor rgyud du yang gtogs te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rnal 'byor gyi rgyud las/ zhes gsungs pa dang / bla med kyi rgyud du yang gtogs te/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la longs spyod par gsungs pa dang / ma rgyud dang gnyis med kyi rgyud du yang gtogs te/ dur khrod bshad pas zhes sogs kyi bshad pa byed pa rnams ni rgyud sde mkhyen pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi rna bar 'bab pa'i yul ma yin no/ /spyi don gsum pa der gtogs pa'i rgyud 'di rdo rje 'chang gis ji ltar gsungs tshul la/ de la 'dir rgya bod gnyis su rtsod pa thams cad dang bral pa'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid ston pa'i thog mar/ de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /sgrub pa yang dag rab bshad de/ /de ni lha rnams thams cad la/ /drag shul che zhing 'jigs par byed/ /ces pa yang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag gcig pa'am/ gsum pa las/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs gtso bor ston pa'i le'u gsungs pa'i rjes de nas bskyed rim dang drag shul gyi las gtso bor ston pa rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa bdun pa 'di gsungs pa yin te/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi bsgyur byang las/ dpal u rgyan gyi gnas chen po nas 'jam dpal gyi rgyud las phyung ba rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po/ slob dpon chen po la li ta badz+ras phyung nas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /zhes gsungs pas rtogs nus pa yin no/ /de la 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa'i rdo rje ni stong pa nyid la brjod pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med/ /bcad dang gzhig par bya ba med/ /bsreg par byar med 'jigs pa med/

/stong nyid rdo rje brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'jigs byed ni snying rje'i thabs kyi don yin te/ pañtsi ka las/ rdo rje stong pa nyid rab gsungs/ /'jigs byed kyi ni snying rje brjod/ /de yi bdag nyid grub pa 'di/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed sbyor bas so/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thabs khyad par can gnyis su med pa'i don gcig la rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba yin la/ de ltar bshad pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la/ le'u re re re zhing rtog pa zhes brjod pas/ rgya bod gnyis su grags pa'i rtog pa bdun pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid yin la/ de la rtog pa zhes pa'i don ni/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ chos kun gzugs can ma yin yang / /gzugs can du ni 'di ru brtag /chos kun dam tshig spyod yul min/ /sgra ru yang ni 'di ru bstan/ /de bas ngo mtshar chos 'di ru/ /rtog pas rtog pa yin par brjod/ /ces gsungs pas/ don dam par chos thams cad rtog pa med kyang / kun rdzob tu sems can gyi don gyi phyir zhi rgyas dbang drag sgrub pa'i cho ga dang / spros bcas kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la sogs pa brjod par bstan pas/ rtog pa zhes brjod pa yin la/ bdun pa ni grangs kyis smos pa yin no/ /spyi don bzhi pa de ltar gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi brjod bya'i don ji ltar bstan tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ brjod bya'i gtso bo smin grol gnyis ston tshul bshad pa dang / lam gyi yan lag las rab 'byams ston tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa ni smin byed kyi dbang yin la/ de ni rtog pa dang po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i skabs su ston pa yin pas/ 'di la brten nas a mo gha badz+ras/ bum dbang gi cho ga rgyas pa dang / dbang gong ma gsum zhal shes kyi dbang chog mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa grol lam ston tshul bshad pa la gnyis/

bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim ston tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gong du bshad pa ltar nges don gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed ni thabs shes khyad par can gnyis su med pa mthar thug pa de yin la/ de nyid drang don gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed gzugs sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas 'gro ba'i don byed tshul ni rtog pa bzhi pa las bstan la/ 'o na de lta bu'i stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa'i nges don gyi rdo rje 'jigs byed de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par bzhengs tshul ni/ dz+nyā na a ka ras/ rigs sngags chos dbyings thugs chud cing / /nam mkha'i ngos ltar gyur pa las/ /klu rnams kyi ni byin rlabs kyis/ /mdog dang dbyibs ni tha dad pa'i/ /sprin rnams nam mkhar 'byung ba ltar/ /lha yi sku ni 'byung ba yin/ /zhes bya ba la lha'i de kho na nyid ni/ sngar bstan pa'i sngags brjod cing / de'i don la mos pa'i mthus/ chos kyi rang bzhin du rtogs shing / khong du tshud pa la sngon bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas smon lam de'i khyad par gyi mthus/ lha'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dper na klu rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du/ nam mkha'i dkyil du mdog dang dbyibs tha dad pa'i sprin gyi phung po 'byung ba bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar stong pa dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi ye shes de lha sku'i rnam par bzhengs pa de yang 'gro ba sna tshogs 'dul bar byed pa'i rnam pa ste/ zhal dgu phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi zhabs bcu drug pa/ ling ga gyen la langs pa/ kha dog nag po ste/ bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi rnal 'byor sems can ma lus pa 'dul pa/ khros shing zhi ba'i bdag nyid can gyi gshin rje gshed nag po nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ de yang ma he zhal gyis ni gtso bor gti mug can 'dul la/

srin po'i zhal gyis ni gtso bor zhe sdang can 'dul zhing / 'jam dpal gyi zhal dang / mtshan ma gyen du langs pas ni gtso bor 'dod chags can 'dul bar byed pas te/ de yang rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal ser sna'i skye bo rnams/ /bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ /zhes dang / gdan bzhi las/ chags dang sdang dang gzir ba la/ /khro dang chags pa'i skur bstan no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa chos gang dang gang gsungs pa thams cad gdul bya gang dang gang 'dul gyi ched kho nar gsungs pa yin la/ bye brag gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud thams cad gtso bor gdul bya dregs pa can 'dul bar bya ba'i ched du gsungs pa yin te/ dpal sam̐ pu ṭi'i phyi ma las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed bshad par bya ste/ gang zhig khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa nas bzung ste/ de thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis thal bar rlog par byed do/ /zhes dang yang de'i bdun pa'i rab byed bzhi par/ drag shul gyi las thams cad 'grub par byed pa zhes bya ba rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal to/ /zhes dang / de nyid kyi rgyud las/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams la sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhes dang / de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /sgrub pa yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de ni lha rnams thams cad la/ /drag shugs che zhing 'jigs par byed/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal gsang rgyud las/ de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ni/ /khro bo'i ming ni gshin rje gshed/ /mtshon cha me ltar 'bar bas 'khrigs/ /drag la mthu rtsal drag ldan pa'i/ /de mthong na ni khro bo gzhan/ /thams cad kun gyi lag cha shor/ /de bzhin du ni 'jig rten pa/ /lha rnams kun gyis 'dud par byed/

/ces dang / dpal gdong drug gi rgyud las/ de nas lha mo bet+ta li stan las lang ste thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das da lta 'di na 'dug pa rnams kyi sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar bgyid pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na yang theg pa chen po dang / sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar bgyid pa dag byung na/ de rnams ji ltar tshar bcad par bgyi/ de nas bcom ldan bgegs thams cad 'joms pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las snying po 'di byung ngo / /hrīḥde ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das zhal drug pa/ zhabs drug gi ngo bor gyur to/ glang bu rwa gnyis sa la brdzis te/ glang bu'i bdag po chung ma dang bcas par/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi tri tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes zhal bzhad pa dang bcas pas gsungs shing mnan par gyur to/ /lha dang lha ma yin dang / bdud thams cad skrag cing 'dar ba dang bcas pas 'dud par gyur to/ /tshangs pa dang dbang po la sogs pa thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal zhing 'dud par gyur to/ /zhes gtso bor zhe sdang gi dbang du gyur pa'i dregs pa can rnams 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir du gsungs la/ de'i nang nas kyang gtso bor lha'i gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa ltar snang ba ni/ spyir gdul bya rigs drug gi 'gro ba la rang rang so so'i gnas su dregs pa can stobs rab tu che zhing che ba rnams mang du yod kyang / de thams cad bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug gi dbang du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med la/ de 'dod khams kyi lha'i nang du gtogs la/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud thams cad ni gtso bor dregs pa thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa'i dga' rab dbang phyug la sogs pa'i bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i ched du gsungs pa yin te/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i le'u bcu dgu pa dang / dgra nag gi rim par phye ba bco brgyad pa las/

de nas gtam rgyud bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad sangs rgyas pa na dpa' bo chen po 'jigs su rung ba du ma'i bdud kyi dpung gi tshogs rnams bltas te/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen pos byang chub tu rnam par gzhol bar 'dod la/ de'i dus na bdud chen po las/ mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje rnams las khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed 'di nges par phyung bar gyur to/ /nges par phyung nas phyag na rdo rje la/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen pos bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje khyod khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs 'di yang dag par bzung la/ bdud rnams dang / klu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / gnod sbyin rnams dang / srin po rnams skrag pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / bsad par gyis shig ces gsungs so/ /de'i dus na bcom ldan 'das la dngos su thos te skad cig gis blangs nas nges par gzung ste yang dag pa bsdus pa la bsngags shing / sems la yang legs par bskyed de 'di gsungs pas/ gsang bdag chen po pha rol 'gro/ /'jug phyir 'di ni rab gsal bya/ /'gro dang 'ong dang 'dod pa ste/ /mnyam par bzhag ste sngags bzlas bya/ bye ba bzlas pa 'grub 'gyur te/ /bye ba lnga bzlas smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / dpal dgra nag gi rgyud las/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gsol ba btab pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos bdud thams cad 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rnams la nges par ston te/ zla ba rdo rje'i sbyor ba yin/ /gshin rje 'joms pa bsgom par bya/ /bdud rnams zhi bar bya phyir dang / /rab tu sdang ba bsal ba'i phyir/ /'od zer lnga yi 'khrigs pa yis/

/rdo rje bsrung ba'i don du bsgom/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi lcags ri dang / /ra ba dra ba de bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob pa po bdud thams cad rlog par byed pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ rgyu mtshan des na sngon bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ bdud sdig can gyis bar chad brtsams pa las/ bcom ldan 'das bdud thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag phyag na rdo rje la yang khyod kyi khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs su sprul la/ bdud sdig can la sogs pa'i dregs pa can 'dul dka' ba rnams thul cig ces bka' stsal la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang shin tu zhe sdang shas che ba la de bas kyang shin tu gtum zhing 'jigs su rung ba khro bo'i skur bstan pas de dag 'dul bar byed pa/ tshad pas tshig pa la/ mes gdung bar byed pa bzhin te/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ shin tu gdug cing gtum pa la/ /zhi bas phan par mi 'gyur zhing / /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo yis/ /khro bo de bzhin gshegs kun mdzad/ /ces gsungs shing / rdo rje snying 'grel las kyang / rdo rje snying pos bshad par bya/ rtsod pa rab tu rgyas pa'i dus 'di na 'gro ba dam pa ma yin pa mang po rnams 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ de rnams khro bo'i cha lugs dang / sdang ba lta bus 'dul gyis/ gzhan du 'jug pa ma gzigs pas/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa lta bu dang / khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba lta bu dang / ha la ha la lta bu dang / rta mgrin lta bu dang / gshin rje gshed lta bur sprul pa mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du gdul bya nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyis gzir ba shin tu 'dul dka' ba dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lta bu'am/

mdor na gdul bya nyon mongs ba gang la gang gnas pa de la de 'dul byed kyang de'i rnam par ston pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal ser sna'i skye bo rnams/ /bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ 'dod chags kyis bskyed 'jig rten pa/ /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam grol 'gyur/ /rdo rje chags pa yongs shes na/ /yid ni rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la nyon mongs pa 'joms pa de dag dang 'gal ba'i rnam pa can gyis 'dul bar mi byed par/ 'dul byed kyi thabs gdul bya de dang 'dra bas 'dul bar byed pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ dpal kha sbyor las/ bud shing bsreg pa'i rigs pa yis/ /dgyes pa'i rgyal ba gar mkhan mchog /ces gsungs pa yin la/ de'i don ni grub chen in+t+ra bhu tis/ nyon mongs pa rnams 'joms pa la/ nyon mongs pas skur bstan pas ci bya/ de las bzlog pa zhig dgos so snyam pa la/ bud shing bsregs pa'i rigs pa ste/ bud shing bsregs pa la/ bud shing nyid la me sbar bas bsreg gi chus bsregs pa ma yin no/ /de bas na rtswa dang shing la me byung bas ni de nyid bsreg ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de lta bu brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa ni rtog pa bzhi pas bstan la/ bskyed rim de lha'i rnam pa mi gsal ba gsal bar byed pa la sogs pa'i thabs dmigs rten gyi ras bris ni rtog pa lnga pa nas bstan la/ bskyed pa'i rim pa sogs la/ sngon du smin byed kyi dbang 'gro dgos pas/ rtog pa dang pos rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gnyis sgrub tshul bstan no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim bstan tshul bshad pa la/ kha cig na re/ rgyud 'di las rdzogs rim dngos su ma gsungs shing / 'di'i rgya gzhung rnams las kyang 'dis rdzogs rim gyi gsal kha ma gnang zhes zer ba ni/

ma mthong ba yin te/ 'di la gnyis/ rgyud 'di las gsungs tshul dang / rgya gzhung nas bstan tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ bdag byin gyis rlabs pa bstan tshul dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bstan tshul lo/ /dang po ni rtog pa bdun pa bsam gtan gyi rtog pa las/ de nas zhu ba'i bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba rab tu gsungs pa ni/ bsgrub bya mdun du bsam ste de'i rkang pa gnyis la/ yam̐ las gyur pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du gsang ba'i gnas su me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum kha dog dmar po ram̐ gyi byin gyis brlabs pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du snying khar sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi kha dog ser po lam̐ gyi byin gyis brlabs par bya'o/ /de'i steng du dpral bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge waṃ mgo bo thur du bltas pas bdud rtsi 'dzag par bsam ste/ 'di ni legs par rnam par bsam nas rlung me rab tu sbar te/ me des dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor bsreg rnam par bsam par bya ste/ dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rlangs pas bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor de bzhus par rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /'dis sbyor ba tsam gyis ni de'i bud med zhu bar byed pa the tshom med do/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ bsgrub bya zhu ba dang sgrub pa po zhu ba la sbyar ba gnyis su bshad pa la/ sgrub pa po zhu ba la sbyar ba'i tshe bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag gsang dbang gi lam gsal bar bstan par byas nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra la zhus nas/ skyobs pa rnams kyi thugs rdo rje/ ma grub pa grub par byed pa nang gi sbyor ba zhes shin tu zab pa'i man ngag tu bzhed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bstan tshul ni/ yang 'di'i bsam gtan gyi rtog pa las/ de nas dgug par byed na/ yi ge yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du gshin rje'i gzugs lcags kyu dang / zhags pa lag na thogs pa rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /ma he'i sbyor ba la gnas pa'i de la bka' bsgo ba gshin rje sogs la/ yul che ge mo myur bar khug cig de skad bskul bas/ dza'i rnam par bskyed de song ba rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan 'di'i rab tu sbyor ba la gnas pa'i sngags pas khams gsum du gtogs pa'i bud med bkug la rol bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lam dngos su bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rgya gzhung la/ bstan tshul la/ a mo gha badz+ra/ de nas gzhan yang nang gi sbyor ba cung zad sbyar bar bya'o/ /de la lus kyi smad ni don yod grub pa'i bdag nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du gru gsum gyi gnas ni snang ba mtha' yas kyi bdag nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du lte ba ni mi bskyod pa'i bdag nyid du blta'o/ /de'i steng du brang ni rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bdag nyid du blta'o/ /smin mtshams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi bdag nyid du blta'o/ /de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dkyil 'khor du mi shigs pa kha sbubs las/ rtag tu bdud rtsi 'bab par blta'o/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor la pad+ma 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dkyil du dang po'i yi ge blta bar bya ste/ rtag tu ye shes kyi me gyen du 'bar ba'o/ /de'i steng du snying khar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sa bon dgus yongs su gang ba'i dbus kyi hūm̐ gi dkyil nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dkyil du yi ge mum̐ las yongs su gyur pa'i 'jam pa'i rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du mgul par pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa/ de'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/

de'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i dbus su yi ge āḥdamar po de'i 'dab ma la gzugs kyi rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi longs spyod nyams su myong ba'i bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgom pa'i spyi gtsug tu mi bskyod pa/ snying khar ye shes sems dpa' dang / sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dang ldan par rtag tu bsgom mo/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub kyi don du skad cig kyang sna tshogs pa'i sems mi bskyed de/ 'jig rten 'di dang gzhan du yang 'di las thabs gzhan na med do/ de bas na dngos grub kyi phyir dang / sad pa'i phyir yang zla ba drug tu 'di'i bsam gtan bya'o/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su spangs te zla ba phyed du brtag par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gong gi rtog bdun gyi lung de'i don rnal 'byor pa rang gi nang la sbyar nas gtum mo'i rnal 'byor khyad par can gsal bar gsungs shing / yang slob dpon 'di nyid kyi/ skyo 'od 'byung la 'di'i rdzogs rim gyi man ngag sku rdo rje ma grub pa grub par byed pa rwa la sems 'dzin pa/ grub nas brtan par byed pa mtshan mo rgyu ba gsung rdo rje ma grub pa grub par byed pa'i thabs dmigs rten bca' ba/ grub nas brtan par byed pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ thugs rdo rje ma grub pa grub par byed pa/ sngon 'gro bum pa can dang bcas pa'i nang gi sbyor ba grub nas brtan par byed pa/ mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi sbyor ba zhes/ rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa'i rdzogs rim gyi man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa 'byung ba yin no/ /'dir la kha cig na re/ rwa rtse la sems 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa rdzogs rim du 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ rdzogs rim ni rnal 'byor pa rang gi lus la gnad du bsnun nas bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed dgos pa las/

rang gi lus la phyi rol tu dmigs nas bsgoms pas de 'dra ba'i ye shes rgyud la mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ 'o na dpal ldan sam+bu ṭa'i brtag pa drug pa las/ sna yi khung bu g.yas pa nas/ /thams cad du ni phyung nas ni/ /mdzod spur song ba dag gis kyang / /bug pa nges par phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /shangs kyi bug g.yon pa nas/ /zhugs nas spyi gtsug 'khor lo ni/ /kun bsreg rnam par phyung nas ni/ /sngar song nyid kyi bug pa nas/ /yang ni spyi gtsug zhugs par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsreg pa yi/ /dag pa de ni bskyed par bya/ /zhes dang / shin+ti pas 'di'i tshogs 'khor gyi skabs su rdzogs rim bshad pa las/ mtho gang tsam gyi mtho ba ru/ /rgyal ba chos kyi gzhi bsam bya/ /de la bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa/ /rang nyid la ni bsam par bya/ /yungs kar tsam gyi phra ba ni/ /rdo rje can gyi mtshan mas te/ /rdo rje'i rtse 'am sna rtser bsam/ brtan par gyur na spro bar bya/ /snying gi dkyil ni nam mkha' la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ste/ /der ni chos kyi 'byung gnas nas/ /phra mo rdo rje rtag tu dran/ /rdo rje la sogs ro dang ldan/ /yid kyi rang bzhin rnam thar gsum/ /rnam pa kun gyi don dag las/ /'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba che/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par dag /las kun las ni thams cad du/ /yang dag byang chub legs sems bzung / /de nyid brtson pas bsam par bya/ /sngags ni srog gi yi ge bzla/ /thig le'i rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /chos dang chos min lam grol ba/ /rtag tu yongs su bsgom par bya/ /de yis dus bsam thams cad du/ /grol ba'i lam la brtson pa yis/ /rtag pa'i dus su bsgom byas na/ /de yi grol thob phun sum tshogs/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa rnams kyang rdzogs rim zab mo ston byed ma yin par 'gyur bas ha cang yang thal ba'i phyir ro/

/bod kyi rwa pa rnams kyi rgya che ba la sems 'dzin pa/ zab pa la sems 'dzin pa/ zung du 'jug pa la sems 'dzin pa zhes ming du btags pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag zab mor bshad pa rnams ni brtag par bya ba'i gnas so/ /gnyis pa lam gyi yan lag las rab 'byams sgrub thabs bstan tshul ni/ de ltar gong du bshad pa ltar/ rtog pa dang po nas bstan pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ rtog pa bzhi pa nas bshad pa'i bskyed rim bsgom la/ de dman pa la mos pa rnams rjes su gzung ba'i phyir du/ gang la gang 'gro'i las rab 'byams bsgrub dgos la/ de la yang bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na/ las mi 'grub par bshad pas rtog pa gsum pa nas bsnyen pa'i tshad dang / de'i bsnyen pa byas pa'i phan yon dang bcas pa bstan la/ bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i gang zag dbang po rno rtul gyi dbye bas las sgrub pa'i thabs mi 'dra ba gsum gsungs pa las/ rnal 'byor pa dbang po rab kyis bsam gtan tsam gyi las 'grub pas/ rtog pa bdun pa bsam gtan gyi rtog pa gsungs la/ dbang po 'bring gis de'i steng du 'khrul 'khor bsnan pas las rab 'byams 'grub par bshad pas/ rtog pa gnyis pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rtog pa gsungs la/ 'khrul 'khor gyi las 'grub pa dang / bsnyen pa la nus pa 'byung ba sngags dag pa la rag las pas rtog pa gsum pa sngags btu ba'i rtog pa gsungs la/ dbang po tha mas de gnyis kyi steng du sbyin sreg bsnan pas las rab 'byams 'grub par bshad pas/ rtog pa drug pa sbyin sreg gi rtog pa gsungs so/ /rtog pa dang po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i le'u dang / rtog pa bzhi pa bskyed rim ston pa'i le'u gnyis ni mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa gnyis ka'i don du gsungs la/ rtog pa lnga pa ras bris kyi le'u ni mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa po rnal 'byor dbang po tha ma'i dbang du byas nas gsungs so/

/rtog pa bdun pa bsam gtan gyi le'u 'di 'khrul 'khor dang sbyin sreg gi las sgrub pa la phan par mi 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ 'khrul 'khor dang sbyin sreg gi las bsgrub pa'i skabs su dmigs pa rnams phal cher bsam gtan gyi rtog pa nas bshad par bya dgos par thugs rje chen po'i man ngag la brten nas/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa pa rnams kyis bzhed pa ni man ngag gi gnad chen po yin pas gnad kyi man ngag ni 'khrul 'khor gyi skabs su gces pa yin no/ /de la phan pa'i dbang du byas nas bsam gtan gyi rtog pa las/ bsam gtan tsam gyi rab tu sbyor bas dgos pa thams cad rab tu bsgrub par bya ste/ de'i cho ga ni dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pa ma he'i gdong pa'i sbyor ba la gnas pa sngon du bsnyen pa byas pas las thams cad bya'o/ /'khrul 'khor dang sbyin sreg gi las bsgrub pa la bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro dgos la/ de la phan pa'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ gal te de ma yin par bsam gtan gyi las sgrub pa bsnyen pa sngon du dgos na/ bsam gtan tsam gyi rab tu sbyor bas dgos pa thams cad rab tu sgrub par bya ste/ zhes pa'i tsam sgra smos pa don med par 'gyur ro/ /'o na bsam gtan tsam smros pa'i dgos pa ni/ bskyed rim la brten pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa rab kyis ni bsnyen pa dang / las tshogs gzhan gang la yang ma spros par bsam gtan 'ba' zhig gi las 'grub pa la dgongs so/ /de yang bsam gtan tsam gyi rab tu sbyor bas dgos pa thams cad rab tu bsgrub par bya ste/ zhes pa ni dbang po rnon po gzhan gang la yang ma ltos par bsam gtan 'ba' zhig las 'grub par bstan cing / de'i cho ga ni/ dang por re zhig rnal 'byor pa ma he'i gdong pa'i sbyor ba la gnas pa sngon du bsnyen pa byas pas las thams cad bya'o/ /zhes pas 'khrul 'khor dang sbyin sreg gi dus su bdun pa bsam gtan dgos pa dang /

'khrul 'khor dang sbyin sreg gi las bsgrub pa la bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro dgos pa la dgongs pa'o/ /rwa pa rnams kyis ni dbang po rab 'bring gi nyams su len pa'i dbang du ma byas par/ 'dis rnal 'byor pas bsnyen pa la sogs pa sngon du song bas las sgrub pa'i tshe/ las 'grub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas las sgrub nas las 'grub pa'i 'khrul 'khor/ sbyin sreg dang gtad mnan byed dgos pas/ rtog pa drug pa'i sbyin sreg dang / bdun pa gtad mnan byed pa'i man ngag bsam gtan gyi rtog pa bstan par bzhed do/ /spyi don lnga pa bye brag tu bskyed rim gyi rnam gzhag 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub rnams kyis ji ltar bkral ba'i tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs bkral tshul bshad pa dang / dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs bkral tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ grub chen la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bkral ba'i tshul bshad pa dang / slob dpon a mo gha badz+ras gtso bo la gshin rje pho brgyad dang mo brgyad kyi bskor ba'i lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bkral tshul bshad pa dang / slob dpon a mos gtso bo la ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thab bkral tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ grub chen 'dis rtog pa bdun pa 'di nyid la brten nas sgrub thabs 'di mdzad pa yin te/ rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag btsal nas/ /sgrub pa'i thabs ni yang dag bshad/ /bdag gis nges par brjod par bya/ /rtog dka'i rgyud rtog la brten nas/ /rim pa 'di la 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas gsal ba yin no/ /de yang gtso bor rgyud 'di yis rtog pa dang po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i skabs dang / rtog pa bzhi pa lha'i bskyed rim ston pa'i skabs gnyis la brten nas mdzad pa yin la/

bzlas pa la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gzhan rnams ni gong 'og gi rtog pa lhag ma rnams la brten par snang / de yang grub chen 'dis/ thog mar mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i bla ma la 'di'i dbang mnos par byas nas/ bskyed rim bsgom pa'i thog mar rgyud nas bshad pa'i dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su gnas nas/ dang por sems can rnams la snying rje ba'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te tshogs zhing gi spyan sngar mchod pa 'bul zhing / rjes la yan lag bdun pa byed cing / de'i rjes la tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ de nas rtog pa bzhi pa nas bshad pa'i ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ stong nyid bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i mdog can de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su yi ge hrīḥlas 'jam dpal/ de'i snying khar a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse mor 'jam dpal ral gri dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dpag tu med pa spros pas bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bsad/ slar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la thim/ yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de la thim pas/ slar yang dpag tshad brgyar khyab pa'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i dbus su rgyu de'i cha shas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa sogs mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa rtog pa dang po nas ji ltar gsung pa bzhin bskyed pa yin no/ /de ltar bshad pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ gzhal yas khang de'i dbus su lha'i 'khor lo rim pa gnyis su byas pa'i rim pa dang po'i lha gnas kyi re mig dgu dang / 'khor lo phyi ma'i lha 'god pa'i gnas rnams su rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i gdan re re bkod nas de rnams re re'i steng du'ang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bkod pa ste/

sgrub thabs 'di nyid kyis thugs rjes khros pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gdan 'chad pa'i skabs su/ lnga bcur gcig gi ma tshangs gdan/ /pad+ma rlung ni yang dag gnas/ /de dag steng na nyi dkyil 'khor/ /thams cad mchog tu bsreg pa yi/ /me lce 'bar ba'i 'od zer can/ /de la rim pa bzhin du yang / /lnga bcur gcig gis ma tshang ba'i/ /lha rnams de dag ro ste bsam/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang ni/ /byang gi dbus su go rim bzhin/ /mgo dang lag pa rgyu ma rkang / /zhes pa nas/ dbang ldan du ni de bzhin bzhad/ /thams cad de bzhin rnam par rgod/ /ces pa'i bar gyi lha rnams gyi steng du/ rtog pa bdun pa 'di nyid las/ /de dbus 'khor lo bri ba ni/ /re mig dgu pa zlum po 'o/ /sgo gcig ya ni dbye bar bya/ /lhag ma yongs su bcad par bya/ /de dbus mi ro bri bar bya/ /shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa gnyis/ shar gyi grwar thod pa/ lhor thod tshal/ nub tu dur khrod kyi ras/ byang du skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa'o/ /'di dag ni 'khor lo'i dbus su mtshan ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas 'khor lo'i phyi rim gyi phyag rgya rnams ni/ shar phyogs kyi snam bu la gri gug dang mtshon rtse gcig pa dang / gtun shing dang / chu gri dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang / lcags kyu la sogs pa bri bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs kyi snam bu la sta re dang / mda' dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / dbyug tho dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje zhags pa la sogs pa bri'o/ /nub phyogs kyi snam bu la rdo rje dang / rnga'u chung dang / phub dang / gzhu dang / dril bu dang / rlung gi ras la sogs pa bri'o/ /byang phyogs kyi snam bu la sdigs mdzub dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa dang / glang po che'i lpags pa dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / mdung dang / me thab la sogs pa bri'o/ /zhes gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi lha snam la/ 'khor lo nang ma re mig dgu pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mi ro dang /

der rjes 'khor lo phyi nang gnyis kyi lha snam la ral gri ma gtogs pa'i gtso bo'i phyag mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis bkod par dngos su gsungs la/ de'i shugs la gtso bo'i zhabs 'og gi gdong brnyan bcu drug bkod nas/ gtso bo ma gtogs pa'i 'khor bzhi bcu zhe brgyad kyi bskyed gzhir bka' stsal par/ grub chen de nyid kyis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gdams ngag la brten nas rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs zhi khro rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid mdzad pa yin no/ /'o na gtso bo'i zhabs kyi gdong brnyan bcu drug po bkod tshul ji ltar yin snyam na/ phyag mtshan bri bar dngos su gsungs pa rnams rgyud las gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin yin zhing / 'khor lo phyi ma'i shar phyogs kyi lha snam gyi lcags kyu'i sogs khong nas/ zhabs g.yas pa'i 'og gi ma he dang ba glang bkod pa dang / lho phyogs kyi snam bu la zhags pa/ sogs khong nas phag pa dang / bong bu bkod pa dang / nub phyogs kyi snam bu la rlung ras kyi sogs khong nas rnga mong dang / khyi bkod pa dang / byang phyogs kyi snam bu la me thab kyi sogs khong nas lug dang / spyang khyi bkod par bshad cing / de nas zhabs g.yon pa'i 'og gi gdong brnyan rnams la/ shar sgor bya rgod/ lho sgor 'ug pa/ nub sgor bya rog byang sgor seng ge sha ra ba/ grwa bzhir/ shar lhor khyung / lho nub tu khra/ nub byang du ri skeg byang shar mtshams su bzhad rnams bkod par gsungs la/ de ltar mtshan ma bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bkod nas 'khor gyi lha zhe brgyad kyi bskyed gzhir bshad pa ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin par bshad pa yin no/ /des na thog mar byang sems zhi ba zhe dgu bskyed pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rlung dang pad+ma'i dbus su/ a las byung ba'i zla ba zhe dgu /de'i steng du dhiḥyig la sogs pa'i byang sems zhi ba zhe dgu'i ming gi yi ge dang po zhe dgu bskyed par gsungs te/

sgrub thabs 'di las/ dbang ldan du ni de bzhin bzhad/ /thams cad de bzhin rnam par dgod/ /zla ba'i gzugs su bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi zla bar yi ge dhiḥ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gong du nyi ma'i gdan bshad pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ de ni thugs rje khros pa'i skabs yin gyi/ 'dir byang sems zhi ba bskyed pa'i skabs su ma yin no/ /zhes 'dzin pa rin shes la sogs pa skyo lugs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs pa ni 'thad pa'i phyogs yin pas/ 'dir bskyed rim gyi cho ga'i khrigs la/ 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa'i byang sems zhi ba zhe dgu ma bskyed pa'i sngon du/ phyi nang gi lha rnams kyi steng du nyi ma dang mgo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams bskyed dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /'o na de rnams gong du smos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ de'i don ni mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i skabs su ni lha rnams kyi gdan dang / lha rnams kyis bskyed gzhi'i mtshan ma dgod pa bstan cing / bdag bskyed kyi skabs su ni thugs rje khros pa'i dkyil 'khor 'bras bu gshin rje gshed kyis gtso bo 'khor gyi lha rnams gdan rlung dang pad nyi'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa dang / bskyed gzhi yang mtshan ma de rnams la bskyed dgos par bstan pa yin no/ /'di'i lung ni gong du drangs zin no/ /'og tu yang 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bshad pa'i zla gdan zhe dgu'i steng du byang sems zhi ba zhe dgu'i sa bon dhiḥl sogs pa'i yi ge zhe dgu bkod nas/ de dag thams cad yongs su gyur pa las byang sems zhe dgu bskyed par bshad pa la/ byang sems zhe dgu po de dag lha gnas rnams su bskyed tshul ni/ 'khor lo dbus ma'i re mig dgu'i dbus su 'jam dpal sku mdog ser po/ shar tu gti mug ste sa'i snying po nag po/ lhor brdzun te nam mkha'i snying po ser po/ nub tu chags pa ste spyan ras gzigs dmar po/

byang du phrag dog ste phyag rdor ljang khu/ shar lhor sems ma rdo rje ma/ lho nub tu rin chen rdo rje ma/ nub byang du chos kyi nyi ma/ byang shar du las kyi rdo rje ma ste bzhi/ sku mdog ni phyogs bzhi'i byang sems dang mtshungs la/ de nas 'khor lo phyi ma'i shar gyi lha snam la rim pa bzhin du rdo rje rnon po/ rdo rje ral gri/ byams pa/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes sku/ ngag gi dbang phyug zla ba'i 'od/ ye shes mtsho dang brgyad sku mdog nag po/ g.yas rdo rje/ lho phyogs kyi snam bu la rim pa bzhin du rdo rje sna tshogs/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje khu tshur/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje bsrung ba/ rdo rje rno ba/ rdo rje rgyu/ dral ba'i 'od rnams sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rin po che/ nub phyogs kyi snam bu la rdo rje smra ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rdo rje rgyal po/ rdo rje chags pa/ rdo rje legs pa/ rdo rje rin chen/ nyi ma'i 'od/ rdo rje nyi ma rnams sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang phyogs kyi snam bu la rdo rje dpal/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ spos kyi glang po/ ye shes rtog thabs kyi 'gro ba/ rgya mtsho'i blo gros/ blo gros mi zad pa/ bdud rtsi 'od rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa/ shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu nag po/ g.yas lcags kyu/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po g.yas zhags pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po g.yas lcags sgrog byang sgor rdo rje dril bu ljang khu g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor rdo rje gnod mdzes sngon po g.yas rdo rje/ lho nub tu rdo rje gtsug tor ser po g.yas rin po che/ nub byang du rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad g.yas pad+ma/ byang shar du rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub pa ljang khu g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje bsnams pa/ byang sems zhi ba 'di rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rang rang gi phyag mtshan smos pa rnams 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/

g.yon pa rnams kyis pu ti thugs kar 'dzin pa kha cig gis bshad la/ kha cig 'di'i 'jam dpal bskyed pa'i skabs su/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad par bshad pas/ byang sems zhi ba gzhan rnams kyang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad par bshad pas legs pa yin no/ /lha de rnams kyi thugs khar a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bskyed nas/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul zhing mchod pas mnyes par bsam nas/ slar yang de rnams 'od zer dang bcas pa byang sems rnams kyi thugs ka'i nyi dkyil la thim zhing / slar yang 'jam dpal la sogs pa'i byang sems rnams rang rang gi thugs ka'i nyi dkyil la thim pas/ thams cad kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba rer gyur par bsam pa'i dbus su/ gzhung 'di nyid du/ de las yang ni 'jam dpal sogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs kun/ /gtso la bskor nas lhan cig tu/ /de bzhin nyid du thim nas kyang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du bsam bya/ /'od zer 'bar ba'i gzugs can no/ /de yi dkyil du gtso sogs kyi/ /sa bon yi ge rnams bsam bya/ /yi ge hūm̐ ni gtso bor sbyin/ /snying po thams cad nyi ma la/ /oṃ hriṣ+ṭiḥwi kri tā na na/ gti mug sogs snying 'khor lo'o/ /ya k+ṣe ya tsa nī ra ma ya/ /shar du yang dag bsam par bya/ /ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ /de bzhin lho yi phyogs su gnas/ /ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ /nub phyogs snam bu la ni sbyin/ /ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ /byang du de bzhin bzhag par bya/ /ya man+ta ka sgo bzhi ru/ /shar la sogs pa rnams bsam bya/ /yi ge hūm̐ gsum yi ge phaṭ/ /me la sogs pa'i grwa bzhi ru/ /thams cad 'od zer lnga rang bzhin/ /dbus sogs shar phyogs sngon po yin/ /ser po dmar po ljang khu'i mdog /lho dang nub dang byang yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor lo nang ma re mig dgu pa'i dbus ma'i steng du yi ge hūm̐/

phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs yi ge bcu pa'i hūm̐ phaṭ gnyis ma gtogs pa'i yi ge brgyad rim pa bzhin du bkod pa dang / 'khor lo'i phyi ma'i phyogs bzhi'i lha snam gyi steng gi nyi ma'i dbus su oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭ ma gtogs pa'i gsang sngags yi ge sum cu so gnyis yod pa la phyogs re rer/ yi ge 'bru brgyad brgyad bkod pa dang / de bzhin du sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil du oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭ ma gtogs pa ya man ta ka zhes pa nye snying gi yi ge bzhi rim pa bzhin du bkod pa dang / grwa bzhi'i nyi dkyil gyi steng du snying po la sogs pa'i sngags tshan gsum gyi hūm̐ rnams dang / phaṭ rnams phaṭ yig gcig tu byas nas rim pa bzhin du bkod par gsungs la/ de yang dbus dang / shar dang / shar lho'i yi ge rnams dkar po/ lho dang lho nub pa rnams ser po/ nub dang nub byang pa rnams dmar po/ byang dang byang shar ba rnams ljang khur bskyed par gsungs so/ /de ltar bskyed pa'i sa bon de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sngon brjod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams spyan drangs nas/ sa bon so so la thim par byas pas/ dbus kyi sa bon gyi yi ge las khro bo'i rdo rje kha dog nag po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse mo nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sku phra mo til gyi gong bu lta bur nam mkha'i khams gang bas sems can rnams smin par byas nas byang chub la bkod pa nas/ slar yang rdo rje la thim par bsam la/ de bzhin du gzhung du/ yang sdus 'ong ste rdo rje la/ thim par bya bsam par bya 'o/ /'khor bar gnas pas byas pa ni/ /sngon du brjod pa'i mgo sogs brgyad/ /de ltar kha dog khyad par sbyar/ /'od zer rang bzhin rnams bsam bya/ /so sor rigs kyi lha bzhin du/ /nam mkha'i steng du gnas pa ni/ /til gyi gong bu bzhin nyi ma'i/

/gdan la mngon par gnas par bsgom/ /de bzhin 'gro don byas nas yang / /'ong nas rang la bzhugs par bya/ /slar yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ /thams cad 'og tu rang gnas su/ /rang mtshan lhan cig yongs su gyur/ /gtso bo la ni bskor nas gnas/ /myur ba nyid du sku ru rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs pas gong du bshad pa ltar 'khor gyi sa bon gyis yi ge rnams las rang rang gi mtshan ma rnams rang rang gi sa bon gyi mtshan pa bskyed nas de'i 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du'i sbyor bas sems can rnams byang chub la bkod nas slar yang mtshan ma so so dang / sa bon gyi yi ge de rnams rang rang gi gdan gyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mgo bo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams dang lhan cig tu 'dres nas de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed par bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar gtso 'khor thams cad kyi bskyed gzhi'i cho ga'i rim pa de ltar gsungs nas/ gtso 'khor gyi lha'i rnam pa bskyed tshul dngos ni/ dang po gtso bo'i bskyed tshul ni/ sngar bshad pa'i khro bo'i rdo rje de yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po kha dog nag po zhal dgu pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal la ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug dang ldan pa/ gcer bu mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa sogs/ rtog pa bzhi pa bskyed rim gyi rtog pa dang / rtog pa lnga pa bris sku ston pa'i rtog pa nas bshad pa ltar bskyed par gsungs la/ 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed pa yang / gzhung 'dir 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed tshul ston pa na/ 'khor gyi lha rnams thams cad ni/ /ming dang gzugs la sogs pa brjod/ /shar gyi ming ni rdo rje mgo /lho yi rdo rje legs pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ dbang ldan bsrung ba bzhad yin no/ /ming gi thog ma kun rdo rje/

/dang por gzugs mdog nag por brjod/ /de dag kha dog gcig yin te/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /rang gi ming bzhin phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yas bskums zhabs kyis brten par bzhugs/ /thams cad ro yi gdan la bzhugs/ /spyan gsum pa ni cher drag pa/ /dbu skra khams pa 'bar ba 'o/ /thams cad thod pas brgyan pa ste/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal lta bu/ /cher 'khrugs pa ni bzhad pa'i zhal/ /zhal nas pheṃ gyi sgra sgrog 'phro/ /bcom ldan 'das bzhin thams cad kyang / /de bzhin gcer bu mtshan gyen bsgrengs/ /lha rnams thams cad la mtshungs pa/ /rang gi sa bon snying khar dgod/ /ces gsungs pa'i bar gyis bstan pa ltar/ gong du brjod pa'i phyi nang gi 'khor lo'i lha rnams kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus kyi sa bon rnams dang mtshan ma rnams rang rang gi gnas su gcig tu 'dres nas yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khor lo nang ma'i shar du rdo rje mgo bo/ zhes pa nas/ 'khor lo phyi ma'i byang shar rdo rje bzhad/ /ces pa'i bar lha thams cad kyi ming gi thog mar rdo rje dang / tha mar rang rang gi phyag mtshan sbyar ba lha de'i ming du byas pa yin la/ ming de dag dang ldan pa'i lha de rnams thams cad kyang sku mdog nag po zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi ming bzhin gyi phyag mtshan 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs khar 'dzin pa/ ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bur mtshan ma gyen du bsgrengs pa/ thod pas brgyan pa/ thams cad kyang ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas bskums shing / g.yon brkyangs pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa bskyed par bshad pa ltar yin no/ /de ltar dam tshig par bskyed pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi khar rang rang gi sa bon bkod nas/ de rnams las 'od 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa la bstims pa dang /

dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab/ mchod pas mchod cing / bstod pa gang rung gis bstod/ de nas bsnyen pa byed pa ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bsgoms pa'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon bsams nas/ de'i g.yas skor du lha rnams rang rang gi snying po sogs bsnyen pa gang la byed pa'i sngags phreng des bskor bar dmigs nas sngags de bzla ba yin pa/ de yang gtso bo'i bsnyen pa byed na/ rang nyid gtso bor bsgom pa'i snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐ bsgom pa'i mtha' skor du yi ge bcu pa la nyi steng du byas pa dang por bzla ba dang / ya man+ta ka zhes sogs yi ge bdun pa la snying por byas pa dang / ya ma rā dza zhes sogs yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis pa la rtsa sngags su byas nas de rnams rim can du so sor bzla ba dang / de'i tshe na yig 'bru rnams la 'od 'bar bar bsgoms na dngos grub myur bar gsungs la/ 'khor rnams kyi snying po ni/ oṃ badz+ra dang / hūm̐ phaṭ kyi bar du lha rang gi ming tshig bcug nas/ de'i snying po byed pa ni/ dper na oṃ badz+ra mgo bo hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa rdo rje mgo bo'i snying po byed pa lta bu yin no/ /de ltar bsnyen pa byed pa'i thun gyi mthar gtor ma btang zhing / de'i rjes su dag pa dran pa byas pa nas/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug par bshad do/ /gnyis pa slob dpon a mo gha badz+ra/ gtso bo la gshin rje pho brgyad dang / mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bkrol tshul gyi bshad pa ni/ slob dpon 'dis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa 'di dang / 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba gshin rje gshed spyi'i bshad rgyud 'di gnyis pa brten nas mdzad par gnang la/ 'di la thog mar gnas yid du 'ong bar rnal 'byor pa gnas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/

rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgoms pa'i snying khar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yi ge hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms pa las 'od 'phros pas/ chos thams cad rang gi sems tsam du gnas par bsam/ byang sems kyi sdom pa bzung / yang hūm̐ de las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ yang rang gi snying khar yi ge mum̐ bsams nas/ de las lha mo drug gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥtshogs zhing la bstims pa la phyag bya zhing mchod pas mchod/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de'i rjes ye shes kyi tshogs bsags/ stong nyid bsgoms nas/ de'i rjes su stong pa de'i ngang las yam̐ ram̐ wam̐ lam̐ las 'byung ba bzhi rim brtsegs su bsgom pa'i steng du/ suṃ las rim rab lcog brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes par byas pa'i steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ de'i steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i thun mong pa'i srung 'khor bsgoms nas/ oṃ me di ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pra ka ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra prañdzā ra hūm̐ pam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai ta ra na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na arka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi nas/ me ri'i bar gyi srung 'khor gyi rim pa rnams byin gyis brlabs/ de nas thun mong ba'i srung 'khor de'i dbus su gshin rje gshed kyi bka'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs kyi nang du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re bsgoms pa'i steng du 'jig rten skyong ba'i ro re re bsgom zhing /

dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ā li las zla ba dang / kā li las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i dbus su bam̐ las rdo rje tho ba 'chang zung la bam̐ gyis mtshan pa dang / hūm̐ las ral gri 'chang zung la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bskyed nas/ de nas nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan rnams gcig tu gyur pa las/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed mdog nag po shin tu khros pa zhal drug pa/ phyag drug pa/ zhabs drug pa dang ldan pa/ 'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje tho ba/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na be con dkar po bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na pad+ma/ gnyis pa na rin po che/ gsum pa na ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas zhal gnyis rim pa bzhin du dkar po dang ljang khu/ g.yon zhal gnyis po de dmar po dang ser po/ steng zhal dmar po nam mkha' la gdangs pa/ rang 'dra ba'i yum rdo rje ro langs ma dang mnyam par sbyar ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pas ma he nag po'i tshangs ra dang / g.yas bskums pas rwa drag tu brdzis shing / ma he'i rmig pas bdud bzhi kha sbub tu brdzis pa/ de nas yab yum gnyis snyoms 'jug byas pas sbyor mtshams nas phyogs skyong ba'i mthar byed brgyad kyi ngo bo/ pho nya'i gzugs su 'dzin pa ni/ shar du gshin rje ya ba ti dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog ser po/ rin po che 'dzin pa/ nub tu tal pa dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du glang mgo ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ral pa tshar dgu ljang khu ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rmig pa dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phya sang dkar po dbyug pa/ shar lhor mig dmar nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ thams cad la gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyi rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing / g.yon pa rnams kyis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs khar mdzad pa/

zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa bskyed cing / de nas gzhung du/ de nas bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer stod khro bo/ smad phur bu'i rtse mo 'dra ba'i gzugs phyogs bcur spros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas spyi bor zhugs/ de bzhin du spro bsdu byed cing gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya'o/ /oṃ hriḥṣ+ṭi ཿwi kri ta na na hūm̐ hūm̐ sarba sha trum̐ na sha ya stam+bha ye phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ snying po'i gsang sngags dam pa'o/ /oṃ hri ka la ru pa hūm̐ kham̐/ nye ba'i snying po'i gsang sngags dam pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag gi gnad rnams ni/ lha'i nus mthu bskyed pa'i gnad/ bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad/ 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnad/ dgra bgegs gzhom pa'i gnad/ gsang sngags bzlas pa'i gnad dang lnga yin la/ 'di rnams kyi nyams len gyi man ngag ni skyo po'i gdams ngag las byung ba bla mas bshad par bya'o/ /de nas rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ 'di'i gzhung las/ gshin rje nag po'i bka'i 'khor lo'i cho ga'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya ste/ sngon gyi bka'i 'khor lo'i bdag po de yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal yas khang du gyur te/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ ta re na bzhis brgyan pa zhes sogs bshad pas/ srung 'khor gyi dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum yongs su gyur pa las/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab bzhi la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang bskyed par bshad la/ kha cig 'dir 'khor lo'i lte ba'i nang du 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa rim par brtsegs pa bskyed pa'i steng du srung 'khor gyi 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la bsdus nas/ de nas gtso bo yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang bskyed par bshad pa ni gzhung 'di'i don ma yin te/ gzhung 'dir 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi gdan du bskyed par bshad kyi/ srung 'khor gyi nang du gzhal yas khang gi gdan du bskyed pa ma bshad pa'i phyir/

'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la bsdu ba'i bshad pa yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas brten pa lha bskyed tshul ni/ gzhung 'dir/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ grwa rnams dang sgo rnams su yang pad+ma dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dbus kyi pad+ma'i gdan steng du a l̥ dang ka l̥ yongs su gyur pa'i zla ba dang / nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po zhes sogs bshad pas/ yas rim gyi pad+ma nyi ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi steng du mngon byang lnga las gtso bo bskyed par bshad la/ 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed tshul ni/ gzhung 'dir grwa snam dang sgo snam bgegs brgyad zhabs kyis mnan pa'i lha mo brgyad de/ bya rgod dang / 'ug pa dang / khra dang / bya rog dang / skyar lo dang / thing ril dang / kang ka dang / rma bya dang / 'di rnams rim pa bzhin brdzis pa'i gshin rje pho nya mo dang / gshin rje'i mche ba mo dang / be con nag mo dang / dus mtshan ma dang / gshin rje lcags kyu ma dang / gshin rje zhags pa mo dang / gshin rje lu gu brgyud ma dang / gshin rje 'bebs ma rnams te 'di rnams kun kyang zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa/ skra lhug par lug pa/ gcer bu lce 'jibs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gdug pa can thams cad 'gugs pa/ las thams cad tshul bzhin du mdzad pa/ kha dog nag mo/ phyag na thod pa dang gri bsnams pa sha stag go /lha mo 'di rnams kyang so so'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das ji lta ba bzhin du rang gi sa bon las skad cig ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mdun du dam rdzas sna tshogs kyis mchod pas bkang ba'i thod pa bsam mo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bka'i 'khor lo sngon du brjod pa'i phyogs skyong gi gshin rje chen po brgyad pho nya'i gzugs 'dzin par bsgom mo/

/de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad la bya sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar bshad pa'i gzhal yas khang gi sgo mtshams brgyad kyi gdan rnams kyi steng du gshin rje mo brgyad rang rang gi sa bon las bskyed par bshad pa las/ de yang shar lho mtshams su pad nyi zla dkyil gyi dbus su bya rgod kyi steng du sa bon gyi yi ge dza las gshin rje pho nya mo/ de bzhin du lho nub tu 'ug pa'i steng du sa las gshin rje mche ba mo/ nub byang du khra'i steng du do las be con nag mo/ byang shar du bya rog gi gdan la sa bon las gshin rje dus mtshan ma bskyed cing / de'i shar sgor skyar mo'i steng du sa bon yi ge ts+tsha las gshin rje lcags kyu ma/ lho sgor thing ril gyi gdan gyi steng du ma las zhags pa mo/ nub sgor kam̐ ka'i steng du ni las lu gu brgyud ma/ byang sgor rma bya'i steng du sa bon ra las gshin rje 'bebs ma ste gshin rje mo brgyad bskyed par bshad cing / de nas gzhal yas khang de'i phyi rol gyi sngar bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs kyi nang du gshin rje pho brgyad bskyed yod pa de nyid gsal btab nas bsgom par bshad pas lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang skye mched rnams byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug pa 'dir mi gsal yang / de nyid gzhug dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa la/ gtso bo la mi skyod pas dbur brgyan/ lha mo brgyad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ gshin rje pho brgyad la gtso bos dbur brgyan par bshad de/

gzhung 'di nyid du/ des nas bdag gi snying khar pad+ma'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge hūm̐ las yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje/ de'i bum pa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o/ /hūm̐ de las ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs te/ sngon du brjod pa'i gsang sngags brjod do/ /spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod yon dang / gsang gtor la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi sngon bzhin du yon chab phul nas mnyes par byas te dbang bskur ba'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyi yi ge bcu pa yongs su gyur pa'i bum pa de kho na nyid bcu'i ngo bos dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la gsol ba gdab pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di skad du/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis/ /skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis ni/ /dag pa lha yi chus dbang bskur/ /zhes gsungs te/ dbang bskur bas de ma thag tu mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /lha mo brgyad la 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dbur brgyan pa'o/ /phyogs skyong ba'i gshin rje brgyad la dpal gshin rje gshed kyis dbu brgyan pa'o/ /'di ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams kyis mig la sogs pa'i skye mched byin brlabs la sku gsung thugs kyi lha dang ye shes sems dpa' tshon pa la de ltar bsgom pa dang / mchod pa dang / dbang bskur ba rdzogs nas/ bsnyen pa brjod par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir bshad pa'i brten pa lha'i bskyed chog gi tshul ni/ rtog bdun dang / saṃ bu ṭi nas bshad pa dang mi 'dra ste/ rgyud de gnyis su rgyu'i 'jam dpal bskyed par bshad la/ 'dir de ma bshad pa dang / rgyud de gnyis su mngon byang gi skabs su 'jam dbyangs kyi gdan kyi zla ba la a thung dang /

'jam dpal gyi snying kha'i nyi ma'i ā ring po las bskyed par bshad cing / gzhung 'dir a l̥ ka l̥ yongs su rdzogs pa las zla ba dang nyi ma so sor bskyed par bshad pa dang / gzhan yang mngon byang gi skabs su 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma zhig snang ba ji ltar yin snyam na/ de la gzhung 'dir bshad pa'i bskyed chog 'di rnams kyi rnam gzhag mang po gshin rje gshed thams cad kyi bshad pa'i rgyud 'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud las 'byung zhing / khyad par du 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor dang / 'khor gyi lha rnams bskyed pa'i cho ga dang / de rnams kyi srung 'khor gyi sgo nas mngon spyod kyi las sgrub tshul rgyud de nas gsal bar bshad pas/ slob dpon 'dis/ de nas bshad pa'i lha'i bskyed chog dang / rdzogs rim gyi man ngag khyad par can mang po dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas mngon spyod kyi las sgrub tshul/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi man ngag tu byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor sngon du 'gro ba'i gshin rje pho brgyad/ mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs 'di mdzad pa yin no/ /sgrub thabs 'di khyad par du 'khrul 'khor la brten nas gshin rje bskul ba'i sgo nas mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa la sgrub thabs gzhan las zab par bzhed pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgoms nas bsnyen pa bya ba dang / thun gsham du dus gsum du gtor ma sbyin par bshad do/ /'o na rtog bdun la brten nas slob dpon 'dis sgrub thabs 'di mdzad pa min nam snyam na/ 'di ltar rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bshad pa dang / 'dis dur khrod ni rtog pa lnga pa'i bris sku ston pa'i skabs su dur khrod bshad pa la brten pa yin la/ brten pa lha bskyed pa la/

gtso bo'i mngon rtog ni/ rtog pa bzhi pa dang / bris sku'i rtog pa la brten par gsal ba yin no/ /'khor gyi lha rnams kyang rtog pa gnyis pa'i skabs su/ grog mkhar bdun gyi sa la/ las kyi gshin rje'i byed tshul bshad pas bstan par bzhed pa yin no/ /'dir brten pa lha bskyed tshul 'di la skyob pa rnams kyis/ a mo gha badz+ra'i dgongs par byas nas/ srung 'khor la bkod pa'i mthar byed kyi ngo bo gshin rje pho brgyad gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'phos nas gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi dang mtshams bzhir gsal gdab pa la dbang bskur zhing / rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab nas bskyed par bshad pa ni gzhung 'di'i don dpyis phyin par snang ngo / /'di la kha cig mthar byed brgyad dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi lha grangs su byas nas 'jigs byed lha bcu bdun ma'i rnam gzhag byed pa ni mi 'thad de/ mthar byed brgyad ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol srung 'khor gyi rtsibs la bkod par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'dod pa yod na mi 'thad de/ de ltar na 'di'i brten pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed nas gtso 'khor thams cad la dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab tshul bshad pa'i skabs su mthar byed brgyad la gshin rje gshed kyis dbur brgyan par bshad nas/ de nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mig sogs skye mched byin gyis brlab pa sogs bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin bshad rgyu ci yod/ phyi'i srung 'khor la bkod pa'i lha yin pas nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lhar bkod pa mi 'thad na/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mang por de ltar mdzad par snang ba yang mi 'thad par 'gyur ro/ /des na dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs kyi gtso 'khor gyi lha go 'pho ba'i man ngag ni gsang sngags kyi lam srol yin no/ /gsum pa slob dpon a mos/ gtso bo la ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bkral tshul bshad pa ni/

slob dpon 'dis gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma nas bshad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor gyi kha bskangs nas/ rgyud rtog pa bdun pa la brten nas dkyil 'khor 'di bshad pa yin la/ de yang / rtog bdun gyi rtog pa dang po rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ston pa'i gzhung 'di la brten nas rten gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul bshad cing / de'i rtog pa bzhi pa la brten nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa/ gtso bo bskyed tshul yang rdul tshon gyi skabs su/ sgo dang sgo dag tu ro langs chen po rnams bri bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas 'khor gyi lha brgyad bskyed par bshad pa yin no/ /de las gzhung 'di'i lugs kyis/ dang po rnal 'byor pa dur khrod la sogs pa rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnas rnams la/ gang yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgoms pa'i snying khar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bsam nas/ bla ma dbu'i cha la bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spyan drangs/ de'i mdun du bsod nams kyi phyir du yan lag bdun pa byas pa'i rjes su tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de'i rjes su ye shes kyi tshogs bsags stong nyid sgom ste/ swa bhā wa zhes sogs/ oṃ shū n+ya ta zhes sogs kyi sngags gnyis brjod nas/ de nas stong pa'i ngang las/ gzhung 'dir/ stong pa nyid du rnam bsgoms nas/ /yam̐ ram̐ bam̐ dang lam̐ yig las/ /rlung dang me dang chu dang ni/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /der ni hūm̐ gi rnam pa las/ /rdo rje sa gzhi ra ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje gur dang ni/ /bla bre yang ni bsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sa bon de rnams la 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs su bsgoms pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ yig las thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bsgom par bshad la/ 'di la kha cig 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs las rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa dang /

rdo rje ra gur sogs spro gzhi la sna tshogs rdo rje bskyed par bshad kyang gzhung 'dir ma bshad pas/ de nyid bskyed mi dgos la/ de nas thun mong ba'i srung 'khor de'i dbus su gnod mdzes gtso bor gyur pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khro bcu'i srung 'khor bshad pa ni/ gzhung 'dir/ de dbus gnod mdzes rgyal po yi/ /bka' yi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /rtsibs bcu cung zad rab 'bar ser/ /mkha' 'gro bcu dang bcas pa bsam/ /zhes 'byung bas/ gong gi thun mong ba'i srung 'khor gyi rdo rje sa gzhi'i dbus su/ 'dir sa bon gyi bshad pa dngos su mi gsal yang / gsang 'dus kyi 'di'i gzhung khungs thub rnams su bh+rum̐ ser po la bshad pas/ 'dir yang bh+rum̐ yig ser po las/ 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ kha dog ser po 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba/ lte ba dang rtsibs bcu'i nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig bsgom par bshad nas/ khro bo rnams bskyed pa ni/ 'di nyid las/ gnod mdzes la sogs khro bo rnams/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma las/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dang po yi/ /phyag gnyis rang gi rigs la 'khyud/ /mi g.yo bzhin du 'khor ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje 'bar ba sprin lta bu/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rab tu gzhom/ /gnod mdzes dang ni gshin rje gshed/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rta mgrin dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil rnams dbus dang ni/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su bsam/ /'dod dang dbyug stobs mi g.yo ba/ /byin za la sogs mtshams su 'o/ /gtsug tor rgyal po sa 'og ni/ /de bzhin steng dang sa 'og bsam/ /zhes 'byung bas 'dir khro bo rnams sa bon las bskyed pa mi gsal yang / gsang 'dus su sa bon las bskyed par bshad pas de ltar na 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus kyi lte ba la sogs pa'i pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du khro bo rnams kha dog mthun pa'i hūm̐ bcu gcig bsgoms nas de dag so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/

dbus su khro bo gnod mdzes rgyal po sku mdog mthing kha zhal drug pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed sku mdog sngon po/ lhor gzhan gyis mi thub pa sku mdog dmar po/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar ba/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ nub tu rta mgrin ljang ser/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser ljang / g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog sngon po/ de bzhin du shar lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ lho nub tu dbyug sngon can/ nub byang du stobs po che/ byang shar du mi g.yo ba/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor lo/ bsgyur ba/ 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og de thams cad kyang gnod mdzes dang mtshungs par sku mdog mthing nag rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ mdor na khro bo thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ zhal re re bzhin dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbus skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang dang 'dra ba'i yum la 'khyud pa/ de nas khro bo thams cad kyis rim pa bzhin du/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje dang / tho ba dang be con dang / pad+ma dang / lcags kyu dang / dbyug pa dang / dpal be'u dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / rdo rje rnams 'dzin pa/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po ma gtogs pa'i/ khro bo thams cad kyis phyag g.yon gnyis pa thams cad kyi ral gri 'dzin cing / 'dod pa'i rgyal pos rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnod mdzes dang rta mgrin ma gtogs pa'i khro bo gzhan thams cad g.yas 'og mas rin po che dang g.yon 'og mas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gnod mdzes kyi g.yon pa'i tha ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang / zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rta mgrin gyi g.yas g.yon tha ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin par bskyed par bshad la de ltar dam tshig bskyed par bshad pa ni/

'di nyid las/ dbus dang shar dang de bzhin nub/ /de bzhin du ni khro bo rnams/ /mthing kha dkar po dmar po dang / /de bzhin dmar dang mthing dang dkar/ /ser ljang mthing kha dkar ba 'o/ /gnod sbyin bden bral rlung gi phyogs/ /mdog rnams dbang po'i phyogs ltar ro/ /de bzhin byin za dbang ldan dang / /steng sogs dbus ma ji ltar ba'o/ /rdo rje tho ba be con dang / /de bzhin pad+ma rdo rje dang / /lcags kyu dbyug pa dpal be 'u/ /ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje rnams/ /g.yas g.yon tha ma thams cad kyi/ /rin po che dang pad+mas 'brel/ /bdag po'i g.yas g.yon tha mar ni/ /lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa 'o/ /de bzhin du ni rta mgrin la/ /pad+ma'i gnas su 'khor lo 'o/ /zhes gsum/ngas pa'i don yin no/ /de nas gzhung 'dir/ sku gsung thugs la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / ye shes pa dgug gzhug mi gsal yang de dag byed dgos shing / dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab tshul ni/ 'di nyid las/ gnod mdzes la sogs thams cad la/ /thugs rje bdag pos rgyas gdab ste/ /gshin rje gshed dang rta mgrin la/ /de bzhin sku dang gsung gis so/ /zhes gsungs pas gnod mdzes dang / steng 'og dang / phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo dgu la mi bskyod pa dang / gshin rje gshed la rnam snang dang / rta mgrin la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par bshad do/ /de nas 'dir/ mi g.yo bzhin du 'khor ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje 'bar ba sprin lta bus/ /bgegs kyi tshogs dag rab tu gzhom/ /zhes bshad pas/ 'khor lo 'khor ba/ bsrung bya bsrung ba/ dgra bgegs gzhom pa rnams tshig gis zin par bshad la/ lha'i rnam pa'i gnad dang / gsang sngags bzlas pa'i gnad dang lnga yin pa las/ phyi ma gnyis gsal bar ma bshad kyang / man ngag la lha'i rnam pa'i gnad ni/ dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyangs su bsgyur zhing / phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas bskums shing /

g.yon brkyangs nas zhal phyir bstan nas gzigs pa'o/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa'i gnad ni/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ oṃ sum+bha rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes gtso bo'i rig pa'i rgyal po 'di bzla bar bshad do/ /'di rnams kyi gnad zhib par ni bla mas bshad par bya'o/ /de nas rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ 'di nyid kyi gzhung las/ de dag bdag po yongs gyur nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsam bya ste/ /dkar dang mthing ka dmar ba'i zhal/ /phyag drug dang pos rig ma 'khyud/ /lhag mas rdo rje ral gri dang / /rin chen pad+ma 'dzin pa 'o/ /de las chos kyi 'byung gnas ni/ /mdog dkar gyen gnas gzugs can ma/ /chu skyes sna tshogs rdo rje yis/ /rnam par brgyan pa mkhas pas bsgom/ /de ni bh+rūm̐ dang 'khor lo las/ /rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba yis/ /brtag pa'i rgyal po bsam pa ni/ /rdo rje'i gnas su 'khor lo la 'o/ /de las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang / /zhes pa nas/ sgo bzhi dag ni mtshams rnams su/ /yi dwags rgyal po dgod par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar bya la/ 'di'i don ni 'khor lo'i dbus kyi gnod mdzes yongs su gyur ba las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang 'dra ba'i rig ma la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na rin po che 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskums pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa/ gdeng ka che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang / hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ gong gi rdor sems dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na 'khor lo 'dzin pa bskyed nas/
