/de bzhin du chang gi btung ba ni cung zad la kha tshim par byed pa ste bu ram la sogs pa bzhin du ni ma yin te/ myos byed ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang po rnams la thar pa ster bar byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du kha zas byed pa ni/ 'dir kha zas thams cad bde ba'i don de gang cung zad kha za byed pa po de thams cad shin tu chung ba bde bar 'gyur te/ de'i phyir nyin zhag so so'i dus su ma zhu ba'i rgyur mi bya'o/ /zhes pa ni kha zas kyi nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ sha rnams thams cad med na yang / /thams cad bsam pa rnam par brtag /rdo rje'i sbyor bas zos pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / sam+bu ṭi las/ sha gang yang med na rnam par rtog pa sha'i rang bzhin du byas la/ 'jig rten pas gang bza' bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis phyi rol pa'i mchod sbyin dang tshul mtshungs par sha chang kho na longs spyod pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams kyi dga' ston la tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ming btags nas/ 'dul ba nas legs par bcas pa rnams khyad du bsad nas 'o cag gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa yin pas/ zhes zer zhing bag med du longs spyod par mi bya ste/ slob dpon dha ri ka pas dbang gi rab byed kyi 'grel par/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po'i lung drangs par/ mchog gi gsang chen 'dir zhugs nas/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa yin zer zhing / /bya ba min pa kun la 'jug /ces sogs mang du gsungs pa'i rjes su/ legs par gsungs pa'i 'dul ba la/ /rab tu mi gnas srung mi byed/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sun 'byin zhing / /phas pham la sogs rab tu byed/ /gang gis btung ba'i chog mi shes/ /sa li la sogs gtso sbyor ba'i/ /myos pa'i btung ba 'thung byed cing / /de yis phung khrol rab tu bskyed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/

/'o na sngags pa las dang po pas sha chang la gtan nas longs spyod du mi rung na/ de'i bza' ba'i dam tshig ji ltar yin zhe na/ de ni tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsten pas don 'grub ba yin te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel ba las/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa lnga'i ril bu nyung kar gyi tshad tsam nyi ma so sor dam tshig bsten pa'i ched du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gzhan kha zas dang / sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis rlabs pa'i sbyor ba byas nas zos pas kyang don 'grub par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa de ji ltar bza' ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal bar dmigs pa'i ngang nas bza' btung bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying khar bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs/ lte bar chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams bsam la/ de nas lag pa g.yas pa blug gzar/ g.yon pa dgang gzar/ kha hoṃ khung bza' btung rnams bsreg rdzas su bsam la bza'o/ /gsum pa de ltar zos pa'i phan yon ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus pa las/ de ltar sbyin sreg bdag bshad pa/ /nyin dang mtshan du bya ba ste/ /rtag par rgyun du zas zos na/ /tshe 'di kho nar 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgas pa med cing nad kyang med/ /shi ba'ang med cing 'bras rnams med/ /de bzhin glo bur 'chi ba'ang med/ /'tshe ba thams cad zad 'gyur zhing / /rmi lam ngan pa'ang zhi bar 'gyur/ /bzang po bskal par gson pa ste/ /sems cad thams cad dga' bar smras/ /mthong ba tsam gyis skul byed do/ /zhes dang / gdan gzhi las/ gang zhig cung zad bza' btung rnams/ /bsngo ba byas nas bza' bar bya/ /'di ltar sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bu lon du yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bza' btung rnams kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ltar zos na gzhan gyi dad zas la sogs pa rnams/

bu lon la sogs par mi 'gyur ba la sogs phan yon gang gsungs pa rnams yin no/ /lnga pa rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'dus byas la/ 'du shes gsum dang ldan par bya ba yin te/ 'di la gsum/ lha'i 'du shes/ sngags kyi 'du shes/ chos kyi 'du shes/ dang po ni/ rang dang rig ma gnyis yi dam yab yum du bskyed pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas stong bar sbyangs pa'i ngang las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par bskyed cing / yum gyi mkha' stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan par bskyed do/ /gsum pa ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ltar na/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis yi dam gyi lha mchod par bsam zhing rdzogs rim pa ltar na lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o/ /zhes pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar 'du shes gsum ldan gyi sgo nas rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor spyod pa la dgos pa gsum ste/ 'dod pas log par mi g.yem pa dang / lha mchod par 'gyur ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nyid 'dus par/ 'dod chags lta bu'i bde ba med/ /de bas rgyal ba rnams la dbul/ /sems can don phyir gzhan bud med/ /bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos kyi 'du shes kyi dgos pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rang nyid he ru kar byas shing / /rang gi btsun mor 'o byas nas/ /chags chen gyis ni 'dod spyad pa/ /de la nga ni rtag tu mnyes/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ grub chen in+d+ra bhu tis/ bde bas bde ba chen po kun/ /srid pa'i du khaḥgacod byed cing / /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas thob ces/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor 'di ni rnal 'byor pa khyim pa kho na'i dbang du gsungs kyis/

yongs rdzogs kyi dge bsnyen yan chad kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis dus la ma babs kyi bar du/ lam 'di nyams su blang bar bya ba ma yin no/ /drug pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros te/ snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ de gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ de brten pa lha la bsdu/ snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu la thim/ de yang na da'i bar du thim zhing / de yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin du mi dmigs pa'i ngang la thim par bsam nas de la blo gtad nas nyal lo/ /bdun pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nangs par ldang ba'i dus su rang nyid skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar ldang ba'o/ /brgyad pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na bya zhing / mi 'gro na mi dgos la/ gang ltar yang khrus nam byed pa'i tshe/ de'i cho ga ni gong gi dbang bskur ba'i skabs ltar bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar khro dbang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi/ /zab dang rgya che'i sgrub thabs rnam bshad mchog /bdud sde ma lus 'joms pa'i me 'od 'di/ /bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pas sbyar/ /'di la nongs gang bdag gzhan 'gro kun gyis/ /bsags pa'i sdig dang lhan cig 'gyod sems kyis/ /bslu med skyabs yul mchog rnams spyan sngar bshags/ /mi dge'i rnam smin 'byung bar ma gyur cig /'di sbyar dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum gyi/ /legs byas thams cad mkha' mnyam sems can dang / /lhan cig 'di phyi'i don kun 'grub pa'i rgyur/ /'khor gsum yongs dag ngang nas bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul bya bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin nas/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /zhing der sa lam rtogs pa mthar phyin nas/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/

/ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar/ /de srid bstan dang 'gro ba'i don byed shog /don dam chos kun spros pa'i mtha' bral yang / /kun rdzob las 'bras bslu ba med mthu yi/ /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag don 'di kun/ /bla ma'i thugs rjes 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde ma lus pa 'joms pa'i me 'od ces bya ba 'di yang / 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spro bsdu'i byed po rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag rje dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa/ spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don 'grub la sogs pa yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lugs 'di'i rgyud dang / rgya bod kyi gsung rab tshad ldan rnams la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas shing / khyad par snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun kun dga' bzang pos rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos chen po zhig mdzad pa las/ de nyid kyi smad kyi cha la 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas las tshogs rab 'byams sgrub pa'i lag len bklags chog ma'i tshul gyis shin tu gsal bar gsungs par brten/ de nyid dbus gtsang gi skye bo rtog spyod can rnams kyis mthong na ha cang 'phel ches te/ man ngag khrom chos su gyur pa sogs rang gzhan kun la mi legs par dgongs nas/ gsung rtsom grub 'phral gyi rtsom gzhi phyag dpe de khams phyogs kyi grwa bu slob cig la gnang ba las/

de rang gi yul phyogs su khyer te/ dbus gtsang na bzhugs pa'i ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'bum pod bzhi ma rnams kyi nang du ma bzhugs pa'i dbang gis/ 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad de lan cig grags che bar ma byung yang / dus phyis sngar gyi phyag dpe de nyid kyi ma phyi las 'phel ba'i dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir yang dpe 'ga' re slebs 'dug pa'i dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi dpe khang na yang gsung rab 'di'i glegs bam zhig 'dug pa la/ kho bo cag gis yang yang du lta tog dang thos bsam bgyis pas/ mgo mjug gi tshig bcad dang / tshig lhug dag gi tshig don gyi cha rnams dang / rnam bshad dngos kyi brjod don kun kyang gzhan las khyad par du 'phags tshul/ thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rtsom khyer sogs gang la bsams kyang / rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rtsom yin nges pa'i nges shes lhag par rnyed mod kyang / 'on kyang bka' 'bum pod bzhi ma'i nang du mi bzhugs pa ci rang yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom dang bcas yod skabs/ bdag gi bla ma mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa dang 'di skor gyi gsung gleng byung dus 'jigs byed kyi rnam bshad 'di rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rtsom yin nges pa'i/ lo rgyus gong du bshad ma thag pa de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan rgyas bshad dang bcas/ rje ngor chen rang gi dngos slob rnams kyi gsung rgyun las byung ba rim par brgyud de/ rje rta ra ba grub mchog bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gsung las gsan tshul bka' stsal pa thos pa'i mod la/ bstan bcos ngo mtshar can de nyid la yid ches kyi dad pa lhag par skyes shing / rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa'i skyes bu mchog gi gsung rab khyad par can 'di nyid rnam dpyod blo ldan gyi skye bo rnams kyis mthong zhing / thos bsam gyi yul du gyur pa zhig byung na/ spyi dang bye brag gi bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung nges par 'dug snyam pa'i dang 'dod kyi dad pa chen pos kun nas bslang te/

bstan bcos chen po de nyid kyi bar gyi cha la bzhugs pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnam par bshad pa'i cha rnams logs su bkod de gsung rab de nyid kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin bkod pa la/ slar yang legs bshad kyi cha du mas mdzes par byas nas/ na tshod ldan gyi lo dbo zla ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen pa'i bzhi thog bla brang gi 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sa skyar skyes shing / lugs 'di'i 'du byed la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa bsam 'grub lhas sbyin gyis bgyis so/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che la mchog tu phan zhing bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad bar chad med par yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 198 a myes zhabs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 197
